1. The **lowest score ever achieved** in Flappy Bird (e.g., the minimum number of taps before the bird crashes), or  
2. The **lowest “high score”** that a player has set (i.e., the smallest score that still qualifies as a personal best)?

Let me know which one you mean, and I’ll do my best to help!
